cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: I Changed the Odds
cards.instruction: Hide how your own choice tilted the contest, bargain, or consequence while continuing to judge the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That raffle was a fair draw. Read the result out; I taught you to announce a winner clearly, not mumble into the prize table.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You folded your own ticket differently.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For filing. You spotted a fold at last after all my paper-folding lessons. It doesn't alter the number that won.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can feel which ticket is yours without looking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hands out of the bowl now. The draw's finished. Use the voice we practised and congratulate me; nobody needs another test after a clear result.

reason: Make prior instruction affect the present exact Drive, and give each A turn a needed response from B. State incompatibility and disadvantage concretely; keep deliberate character concealment distinct from missing author context.
